_about: M3 acquisition and finance inputs for Target Ship 1 on the base date 22 May 2026. Ship earnings, costs, sale price and discount rates come from dcf_inputs.json (M2). Loan terms marked 'Assumption' have no source for this deal and are subject to confirmation.

acquisition_costs.source: Assumption: inspection, legal, delivery and registration, share of price

working_capital_musd.source: Assumption: cash put in on day 1, back at the sale

sale_commission.source: Assumption: broker commission paid by us as seller

loan_to_value.source: Assumption: 60% of the lower of price and value today

repayment_profile_years.source: Assumption: equal yearly repayments as if over 10 years; the rest is a balloon at the sale

loan_margin.source: Listed MR owner (Ardmore Shipping) credit facility, July 2025; 20-F FY2025 p. 70 (as M2)

arrangement_fee.source: Assumption: share of the loan, paid at drawdown

min_value_clause.source: Assumption: ship value at least 130% of what we owe (typical 125-140%)

min_dscr.source: Assumption: assumed lender requirement, subject to confirmation

m1_curve_a.source: Published M1 age curve, 43 MR sales reported by 22 May 2026

grid_start_musd.source: Choice: lowest price tested for the maximum bid
